newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates mostly soft, one-week steady.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates mostly soft, one-week steady.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) dipped in most maturities on Friday, with only the one-week rate unchanged, traders said.
A foreign bank dealer said PHIBOR continued to reflect the long-term view that interest rates would soften due to lower inflation and cuts in banks' reserve requirements.

Only the one-week rate held on to its previous level after the Central Bank decided not to raise its overnight borrowing rate inspite of the recent weakness in the peso, dealers said. PHIBOR represents rates at which banks would be willing to swap their pesos for dollars.
